newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to tender 29.3 pct KomiTEK April 18 - Fund.
newsitem.headline: Russia to tender 29.3 pct KomiTEK April 18 - Fund.

text.p: Russia will sell a 29.3 percent stake in Komitek oil holding company, whose main production unit is AO Komineft, in an investment tender with bids accepted from March 21 to April 18, the Federal Property Fund said on Tuesday.
The minimum bid for the 48,680,800 shares of KomiTEK was 17 billion roubles plus a promise of $10.8 million in investment, the fund said in its regular bulletin, Reforma.

It said investment would be used towards a $113.2 million oil pipeline. Of the investment, $7 million would have to be paid within a month of concluding the sale and the remaining $3.8 million would have to be invested by June 30.
The fund said the tender winner would also have to pay KomiTEK's debts to the federal budget as of March 1, though it did not say what these amounted to.
It said foreign investors were not allowed to bid for the stake, the results of which would be announced on April 21.
